scenario.title: Online Education - Course Enrolment
scenario.problem: Low enrolment completion: weak click-through from course information to enrolment and high abandonment during registration.
scenario.hypothesis: If we shorten registration to a single step and add a sticky 'Enrol now' CTA on course pages, then enrolment conversion will increase, because fewer steps and a persistent next action reduce friction at the two biggest drop-off points.

decision.label: Ship B - phased rollout
reasons: Bounce-rate guardrail passed the non-inferiority test.
caveats: The effect may differ by Device (interaction p=0.044); Desktop showed no lift. This is one of several interaction tests, so confirm with a targeted follow-up before personalising.

Lift above 50% is unusually large for a UI change (Twyman's law). Expect a smaller effect at full rollout; re-measure at 4-6 weeks. At this sample size, if the true lift were 20%, significant results would overstate it 3.3x on average.
The test is below the 5,548-per-arm sample planned for a 20% lift, so the uplift estimate is imprecise (95% CI +12% to +132%).

scenario.title: Travel Booking - Hotel Reservations
scenario.problem: Low booking completion: poor click-through from search results to booking pages and high abandonment in the booking/payment flow.
scenario.hypothesis: If we show total price (incl. fees) on search results and collapse booking + payment into one page with express wallets, then booking conversion will increase, because price surprises and form length are the main causes of checkout abandonment.
scenario.change: Transparent total pricing + one-page checkout with express pay

scenario.title: Charity - Online Donations
scenario.problem: Low donation completion: weak conversion from campaign pages and high abandonment on the donation form.
scenario.hypothesis: If we add suggested donation amounts tied to concrete impact ('$50 = one week of meals') and trim the form to essentials, then donation completion will increase, because anchoring and tangible outcomes lower decision effort.
scenario.change: Impact-anchored preset amounts + shorter donation form

scenario.title: SaaS - Free-Trial Sign-up
scenario.problem: Low free-trial sign-up rate: high exits from the pricing page and poor click-through from product features to sign-up.
scenario.hypothesis: If we add a 'Start free - no card required' CTA on the pricing page and defer account setup until after first use, then trial sign-ups will increase, because perceived commitment is the main barrier at pricing.
scenario.change: No-card trial CTA on pricing + deferred account setup
